text:
Maria Gonzalez: Starting Q3 planning thread for Private delivery. Need to lock phasing for VPC control plane, on-prem packaging, and air-gapped bundle. Who can call must-have vs nice-to-have for pilots? cc @Alex @Samir

Alex Chen: My proposed sequence:
- Phase 1: VPC "control plane in customer VPC" (auth, routing, basic telemetry opt-out)
- Phase 2: On-prem packaging (installer, node agent, upgrade tooling)
- Phase 3: Air-gapped/offline bundle + attestation
Must-haves for Phase 1: RBAC, model pinning, routing policies, perf baseline, HA targets (99.9%)

Samir Patel: ops notes:
- KMS/HSM integration = must for several customers
- Private registry + internal OCI mirror for images to support on-prem and airgap
- Allow configurable egress rules; otherwise airgap blocked

Jen Li: commercial asks: prioritize VPC CP for 3 pilot customers, then on-prem for 2 regulated accounts, airgap after. OKR suggestion: "Private: complete 3 pilot onboardings" by end of Q3.

Kevin O'Neill: engineering constraints and risks:
- Runtime needs deterministic startup behavior for on-prem installs
- Packaging should support quantized model blobs to lower infra footprint (nice-to-have for Phase 2)
- Upgrade strategy: in-place is simplest but we should define a blue/green fallback for safety

Eva (product): proposed launch criteria per phase:
Phase 1 (VPC CP):
- 3 pilot customers live
- End-to-end auth + RBAC smoke tests passing
- Perf baseline + latency SLO documented
- Runbook + rollback documented

Phase 2 (On-prem):
- Installer + idempotent upgrades
- Automated install e2e tests (simulate airgap)
- KMS integration validated
- Support SLA and runbook

Phase 3 (Air-gap):
- Offline bundle validated on customer infra
- Signed artifacts + attestation flow
- Security sign-off + pen test scheduled

Samir Patel: blockers for airgap we need to solve:
- OS-level dependency matrix across customer distros
- Customer proxy/NAT templates and sample network configs

Alex Chen: tentative timeline:
- Apr-May: build Phase 1 + internal pilot
- Jun: external pilots + docs
- Jul-Aug: Phase 2 packaging + installer certs
- Sep: Phase 3 airgap pilot + pen test

Maria Gonzalez: product priorities:
- Prioritize control plane features that unblock pilots (auth, routing, model pinning)
- Defer telemetry enhancements that aren't pilot blockers
- Need clear owners for docs and install playbook (Jen, can you own?)

Jen Li: I can own docs/playbook and will pair with Samir for the installer test harness. Deliverable: install checklist + terraform examples by 2026-06-10.

Kevin O'Neill: owners:
- Runtime packaging: Kevin
- Installer & agent: Samir
- Control plane features: Alex
- Security & signing: Diana

Diana (security): noted. We'll draft a threat model and target a pen test window in Sept. Need threat model done before Jul.

Maria Gonzalez: Action items YAML:
- Alex: Phase 1 feature list + SLA targets (due 2026-04-28)
- Samir: installer POC + test harness (due 2026-06-10)
- Jen: docs + terraform templates (due 2026-06-10)
- Kevin: runtime packaging plan + upgrade strategy (due 2026-05-15)
- Diana: threat model + pen test schedule (due 2026-07-01)

Samir Patel: open question: pilots - do we require dedicated Dedicated capacity or can we use hosted fallback behind VPC? This impacts infra work.

Alex Chen: for pilots we can use hosted fallback to lower ops burden. For GA customers will expect isolated pools; add as GA requirement.

Maria Gonzalez: decision: pilots use hosted fallback in VPC; GA requires dedicated pools. I'll update roadmap and OKRs.

deploy-bot: control-plane branch merged to infra/staging at 2026-04-02T11:22Z :white_check_mark:

Maria Gonzalez: thanks all. Next sync Wed 2pm. Please drop progress updates in this thread by EOD Friday; I'll consolidate for roadmap review.
